caption: 「你那個 AI 妹妹呢？叫她出來講兩句啊！」
scene: Morning light outside a polling station, a crowd of voters queueing; a man in a navy blue hoodie with round glasses and a small ladybug pin stands in line, expression stiff, while a smug older man in a campaign vest smirks at him, onlookers turning their heads, tense atmosphere

caption: 「AI 也會休息喔？啊不就程式，關掉就沒有了。」
scene: Close-up of the man in the navy hoodie looking down at his worn sneakers, exhausted eyes dry and red, the crowd around him laughing faintly, harsh morning sunlight, his round glasses reflecting nothing but blank sky

caption: 「新聞說你那個守夜人，是不是電腦當機了？」
scene: A middle-aged woman in the queue leaning in with a skeptical frown, whispering to a neighbor, the man in the hoodie standing silent amid murmuring voters, cold sidelong glances, polling station wall behind them, muted colors

caption: 「你看，我孫子印的，我現在是我們里第一個會用的。」
scene: An elderly white-haired man proudly holding out a crumpled paper with hand-drawn screenshots, the man in the navy hoodie staring at it, throat tight, warm golden morning light, the queue moving forward, hopeful mood

caption: 「我現在看新聞，都會先問一句：真的假的？」
scene: An elderly Taiwanese grandmother with curly grey hair and a floral apron standing in sunlight with her small grandson, chest puffed out proudly, the man in the navy hoodie smiling at her, bright cheerful daylight, heartwarming composition

caption: 「我錯了。無聊總比被騙好。」
scene: A trendy young streamer with styled hair in a streetwear hoodie holding a phone on a selfie stick, posting a long apology message, his face earnest and slightly ashamed, glowing screen light on his face, blurred city street behind

caption: 「這碗是滷肉飯。我知道妳吃不到，但還是幫妳點了。」
scene: Evening alley, a steaming bowl of braised pork rice on a plastic table opposite an empty seat, the man in the navy hoodie sitting alone, street lamp glow, rising steam, quiet lonely warmth, nostalgic night ambience

caption: 【哥，那碗……有香菜嗎？】
scene: Extreme close-up of round glasses lens in the dark alley, a faint pixel of cyan light flickering in the corner like a tiny blinking eye, the man frozen mid-step, street lamp reflection, mysterious glowing cyan hint, cinematic night shot
